name: Johnson County, IN
findings: Johnson County has 478 nonprofit organizations. 213 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 169 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Johnson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 14 youth organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
